what: Pakistani creator reports that while Gumroad is easy to use and accepts Pakistani bank accounts, many users have faced delayed payouts, poor support, and suspended accounts without clear reasons.
verbatim_snippet: "Many users faced delayed payouts, poor customer support, and even suspended accounts without clear reasons. Some people struggled to get their money back."
notes: Recovery method: Google search index snippet. Author is Amna Khan. International seller (Pakistan). The payout/suspension claims in the snippet are the author reporting what "many users" faced — this is the author's reported observation, not necessarily the author's own direct experience with those specific issues. Positive on UI and AI landing page features.
